int.ui.bounty_text: The weekly bounty kinds are part of the running season: the weeks still to come are drawn from the new list, so the season's standings can change.
int.ui.recheck_all_text: Checks every officer's badges against their saved runs, and gives or takes away what changed. Badges an admin granted or revoked by hand stay as they are.
int.ui.source_short: With the department accounts as the source, some departments cannot pay what they already owe. Rows that cannot be paid become unfunded (final). Add money to those accounts first.
int.ui.source_text: Payments will come from each department's account. These are the balances and the held or pending pay each one would then pay.
int.ui.trial_text: {n} of {checked} missions would not load with this value. They stay off until the value is changed back.
integrations.off.dispatch: No dispatch script in use (Config.Integrations.dispatch = '{setting}'). The tablet's own Dispatch still works, but officers who respond to a real call are not released from their run, and suspended officers are not kept off duty. Start sc-dispatch or ps-dispatch, or set it to 'none' if you have neither
integrations.off.ambulance: No ambulance script in use (Config.Integrations.ambulance = '{setting}'). A downed participant is always picked up and revived by Crimson-Police, and only a dead character counts as down. Start sc-ambulance or qbx_ambulancejob, or set it to 'none' if you have neither
integrations.off.banking: No banking script in use (Config.Integrations.banking = '{setting}'). Payouts get no bank history entry, and Cash.source 'society' pays new money like 'server'. Start Renewed-Banking, or set it to 'none' if you do not use it
integrations.off.police: No police script in use (Config.Integrations.police = '{setting}'). NPC missions and Crimson-Police's own custody work as usual; live crimes and volunteer suspects stay off. Start sc-police or qbx_policejob, or set it to 'none' if you have neither
integrations.needs.police_facts: Off: live crimes and volunteer suspects need a police script that reports cuffing and jailing (sc-police; qbx_policejob does not report cuffing). Police script now: {police}
integrations.no_adapter: Crimson-Police has no adapter for '{setting}' (Config.Integrations.{kind}), so it uses no {kind} script and the features that need one are off. Pick a supported script or 'none', or add an adapter (docs/dev/INTEGRATIONS.md, Adding an adapter)
integrations.not_started: {name} serves {kind} but is not started, so the features that need a {kind} script answer as if there were none. Start {name}, or set Integrations.{kind} to 'auto' or 'none'
